basis: The gasket is referenced but not tied to a component specification or supplier record.
No manufacturer specification establishes the asserted material content.
The work order and testimony contain a genuine repair-history conflict.
Handling is alleged, but the handled component is not sufficiently identified as the asserted material.
No quantified dose, duration, or measurement is supplied.
The synthetic expert record supplies no causation opinion.
The record does not establish every required liability link.

non_claims: Product identification does not establish material content, exposure, dose, causation, or liability.
All records and outcomes are synthetic.
